name: decksfx
does: The party start at her decks as it was, to compare: the sparkles, the pillar of light, the dome, the light, the shake, the floor glow and the heat ripple (their knobs: the pause page's Party start), and no analyser ring round the decks.
decision: The soundsystem spell's analyser ring round the decks by default (Ed, 2026-11-12: "At the decks, when the party starts, there is a visual effect - I want to remove this. ... Instead I want something like the soundsystem spell (audio analyser ring)")
